grades.quote: The commit entry in the log must be written to persistent storage before the commit operation is complete.
grades.reason: Provides general commit-record background, but not xv6’s concrete on-disk replay/discard condition.

grades.quote: As long as the redo entries are in the log before the commitment marker, and all of them are in persistent storage before the commit operation completes, the system will ensure durability.
grades.reason: Explains general redo-log durability, but does not identify how xv6 decides whether to replay its log.
The summary gives no crash-recovery or log-commit decision details.
Discusses recovery of unlinked inodes, not deciding whether to replay or discard a log transaction.
